memberdef.name: enableLoadCacheBypass

briefdescription.para: Update MI memory load instruction to bypass any caches up to the Scope memory scope for address spaces AddrSpace.

detaileddescription.para: Return true iff the instruction was modified.

inbodydescription.para: The scratch address space does not need the global memory caches to be bypassed as all memory operations by the same thread are sequentially consistent, and no other thread can access scratch memory.
Other address spaces do not have a cache.

memberdef.name: enableStoreCacheBypass

briefdescription.para: Update MI memory store instruction to bypass any caches up to the Scope memory scope for address spaces AddrSpace.

detaileddescription.para: Return true iff the instruction was modified.

inbodydescription.para: Do not set glc for store atomic operations as they implicitly write through the L1 cache.
The scratch address space does not need the global memory caches to be bypassed as all memory operations by the same thread are sequentially consistent, and no other thread can access scratch memory.
Other address spaces do not have a cache.
The L1 cache is write through so does not need to be bypassed. There is no bypass control for the L2 cache at the isa level.

memberdef.name: enableRMWCacheBypass

briefdescription.para: Update MI memory read-modify-write instruction to bypass any caches up to the Scope memory scope for address spaces AddrSpace.

detaileddescription.para: Return true iff the instruction was modified.

inbodydescription.para: Do not set glc for RMW atomic operations as they implicitly bypass the L1 cache, and the glc bit is instead used to indicate if they are return or no-return.

Do not set GLC for RMW atomic operations as L0/L1 cache is automatically bypassed, and the GLC bit is instead used to indicate if they are return or no-return. Note: there is no L2 cache coherent bypass control at the ISA level.

briefdescription.para: Inserts any necessary instructions at position Pos relative to instruction MI to ensure memory instructions before Pos of kind Op associated with address spaces AddrSpace have completed.

detaileddescription.para: Used between memory instructions to enforce the order they become visible as observed by other memory instructions executing in memory scope Scope.
